label: Emirates ID
validation: 15 digits as 784-YYYY-NNNNNNN-C; starts with 784; Luhn check digit
notes: 784 is the UAE's ISO 3166 / UN M49 country code. The issuer does not publish the check-digit rule; the Luhn rule comes from data-loss-prevention vendor documentation (Microsoft Purview). The YYYY part is usually the birth year but this is not checked.
